Name: Polyculture Tracker
Author: alvesgu
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Polyculture Tracker highlights the 28 crops that count toward the Polyculture achievement in your Collections -> Shipped tab, so you always know where you stand. Items you've shipped 15 or more of get a gold indicator; items you've shipped at least once but not yet 15 get a blue one. Other items in the tab (fish, artisan goods, forage, etc.) are not affected. Three indicator styles to choose from: a silhouette outline, a glowing circle behind the sprite, a small star in the corner.
[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Unzip the downloaded file into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI as usual.[/*]
[/list]To configure: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and open Mod Options from the title screen. Alternatively, edit Mods/PolycultureTracker/config.json by hand.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Tracks the 28 crops the Polyculture achievement requires;[/*]
[*]Three indicator styles: [b]Outline[/b], [b]Circle[/b], and [b]Star[/b];[/*]
[*]Separate configurable colors for complete (≥ 15 shipped) and incomplete (1–14 shipped) items;[/*]
[*]Live color preview in the settings menu while you move the sliders;[/*]
[*]Indicators stay mostly visible while browsing. The item detail popup tries to render cleanly on top, though it's not perfect;[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0 or later. [url=https://smapi.io]smapi.io[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings.[/color]
